description: This file contains utility functions for data table filtering, including text, multi-select, single-select, number, and date range filters, as well as functions for converting faceted values to and from maps. It also exports a CSS class name constant.

methods.name: textFilter
methods.description: Filters cell values based on text filter criteria such as equals, contains, startsWith, endsWith, isEmpty, and isNotEmpty.

methods.name: isTextFilterValue
methods.description: Type guard to check if a filter value is a TextFilterValue.

methods.name: multiSelectFilter
methods.description: Filters cell values based on multi-select filter criteria, supporting string and number arrays.

methods.name: isMultiSelectFilterValue
methods.description: Type guard to check if a filter value is a MultiSelectFilterValue.

methods.name: singleSelectFilter
methods.description: Filters cell values based on single select filter criteria.

methods.name: isSingleSelectFilterValue
methods.description: Type guard to check if a filter value is a SingleSelectFilterValue.

methods.name: numberFilter
methods.description: Filters cell values based on numeric comparison operators such as eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte.

methods.name: dateRangeFilter
methods.description: Filters cell values based on whether dates fall within a specified range.

methods.name: isNumberFilterValue
methods.description: Type guard to check if a filter value is a NumberFilterValue.

methods.name: isDateRangeFilterValue
methods.description: Type guard to check if a filter value is a DateRangeFilterValue.

methods.name: dataTableFilter
methods.description: Main filter dispatcher that applies the appropriate filter based on filter value type.

methods.name: convertFacetedValuesToMap
methods.description: Converts an array of FacetedValue objects into a Map with FacetedValue keys and numeric values.

methods.name: convertMapToFacetedValues
methods.description: Converts a Map of FacetedValue keys back into an array of FacetedValue objects.
